name: omnidiff
description: Syntax-aware diff highlighting, backed by the omnidiff CLI
author: Marko Ivankovic

colors.description: Background of code omnidiff reports as inserted.
Background of code omnidiff reports as deleted.
Background of code omnidiff reports as updated in place.
Background of code omnidiff reports as moved, and of its counterpart on the other side.

omnidiff.binaryPath.markdownDescription: Path to (or name of) the `omnidiff` binary. Leave at the default to use the binary bundled with this extension when there is one, falling back to `PATH`. Any other value wins over both, so point this at your own build to use it.

enumDescriptions: Use whatever is persisted in omnidiff's own config - the nearest .omnidiff.toml at or above the file being diffed, else your user-level one.
The tightest reading: drop standalone brackets and separators, trim leading whitespace.
The fullest reading: keep standalone brackets and separators, keep leading whitespace.
Use the omnidiff.render.* options below, ignoring omnidiff's own config entirely.
omnidiff.renderMode.markdownDescription: Which ranges omnidiff paints. `default` defers to omnidiff's own config; `minimal` and `full` pass `--minimal`/`--full` and override it; `custom` uses the `omnidiff.render.*` options below, which are the same six the terminal UI offers under its `M` panel.

omnidiff.render.leadingWhitespace.markdownDescription:
Keep the whitespace a range starts with, on every one of its lines, instead of trimming back to the first real character.

Only applies when `#omnidiff.renderMode#` is `custom`.

omnidiff.render.structuralPunctuation.markdownDescription:
Paint ranges that are nothing but brackets, separators and whitespace - `(`, `)`, `[`, `]`, `{`, `}`, `,`, `;`, `:`. Operators are never dropped by this: an edit from `<` to `<=` is the whole edit.

Only applies when `#omnidiff.renderMode#` is `custom`.

omnidiff.render.wholePairUpdates.markdownDescription:
Highlight an updated pair whole - both `argument` and `i_am_an_argument` - instead of narrowing to the part that actually differs.

Off in both `minimal` and `full`: this decides which ranges the diff *has* rather than how much of a decided range gets painted, so it sits on its own axis.

Only applies when `#omnidiff.renderMode#` is `custom`.

omnidiff.render.paintReindentOnlyMoves.markdownDescription:
Report a relocation as a move even when it is a pure reindent - nesting added or removed around otherwise untouched content, as when a Rust `if let` chain collapses.

Only applies when `#omnidiff.renderMode#` is `custom`.

omnidiff.render.paintDisplacedMoves.markdownDescription:
Report a node as moved when it was pushed along by an edit beside it rather than moved in its own right.

Only applies when `#omnidiff.renderMode#` is `custom`.

omnidiff.render.paintResizedMoves.markdownDescription:
Report a move whose two sides are different sizes.

Only applies when `#omnidiff.renderMode#` is `custom`.
